business_summary: Jinyu Bio-technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of veterinary biological products in China and internationally. The company's products focus on preventing porcine mycoplasmal pneumonia, pseudorabies, highly pathogenic avian influenza, brucellosis, and other Class I, II, and III animal diseases. It also provides pig vaccines, swine foot-and-mouth disease type O and A bivalent inactivated, porcine circovirus type 2 baculovirus vector inactivated, porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome chimeric virus live and inactivated, and swine fever live, transmissible gastroenteritis in pigs, swine live influenza bivalent, bovine viral diarrhea/mucosal disease, infectious rhinitis two-dose inactivated, brucella gene-deleted live, brucellosis live, inactivated emphysema and gangrene, ruminant disease live, newcastle disease, infectious bursal disease trivalent inactivated, recombinant avian influenza virus trivalent inactivated, infectious bronchitis symptoms, egg drop syndrome type 4 quadrivalent inactivated infectious bronchitis, canine distemper and parvovirus bivalent live, feline panleukopenia calicivirus disease trivalent inactivated trivalent, and inactivated rabies vaccines. Further, the company manufactures and sells biological pharmaceutical preparations, and chemical reagents and auxiliaries; develops biotechnology; transfer and consulting services; advanced medical equipment and instruments; import and export of goods and technology; and provision of property management services. Additionally, it is involved in real estate activities; biochemical products; planting; hotel management services; internet information service finance; biotechnology promotion services; owner-owned house for rent; mechanical equipment processing; investment management; management, meal, technical, and medical services; and trading activities. Jinyu Bio-technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Hohhot, China.
